text:
lian: quick sync — we've got multiple reports from Expo/React Native folks: importing the JS SDK causes bundler/runtime errors (ESM/CJS entry mismatch + missing node builtins like crypto/stream). anyone dug in?

ben: seen it. root cause is our package.json conditional "exports" and metro. Metro (and older rn metro) ignores conditional "exports" and prefers the `main`/`module` fields in odd ways. result: RN gets the wrong entry (node-targeted ESM) or a build that references ReadableStream/Buffer. error logs look like: 
```
Invariant Violation: "Can't find module: stream"
TypeError: undefined is not a function (evaluating 'new ReadableStream(...)')
```

jess: expo managed users get hit hardest. expo doesn't ship node:crypto or native streams. typical quick fixes: polyfill globalThis.crypto with expo-crypto or add react-native-crypto + react-native-randombytes. but these are noisy for customers.

alice: high-level options: ship a separate "react-native" entry in package.json exports, ship a CJS bundle that avoids node builtins, and include a tiny RN compatibility shim that sets globalThis.crypto, TextEncoder, and a minimal stream polyfill.

ben: example package.json snippet that works: 
```json
{
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "react-native": "dist/rn/index.js",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "dist/cjs/index.js",
      "react-native": "dist/rn/index.js"
    }
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

jess: +1 to the react-native key. Metro respects that field. shipping dist/rn/index.js that is a tiny wrapper (re-exports APIs but imports rn-friendly impls) has worked in other libs.

lian: for polyfills the minimal runtime shim we use in other repos: 
```js
// rn-shims.js (included by OSS package or pointed at in README)
import 'react-native-get-random-values'; // fills crypto.getRandomValues
import { encode as encodeUTF8 } from 'text-encoding';
if (!globalThis.crypto) globalThis.crypto = { getRandomValues: globalThis.getRandomValues };
if (!globalThis.TextEncoder) globalThis.TextEncoder = encodeUTF8;
// simple readable stream fallback for small payloads
if (!globalThis.ReadableStream) {
  globalThis.ReadableStream = class { constructor() { throw new Error('ReadableStream unsupported in RN — use fetch text/json fallback'); } }
}
```

ben: also add docs: "If you use Expo managed, add `import 'my-sdk/rn-shims'` at top of app or use `patch-package` to auto-inject during bundling."

alice: typing note: TS users on RN still expect declaration files. make sure dist/types maps and has `types` field and that the rn build references the same d.ts (no conditional types that depend on node typings). otherwise builders pull in @types/node and that breaks.

jess: edge runtime compatibility: when running on edge (Cloudflare/Next edge) we ship an ESM/streaming-first implementation. RN apps are not edge — but customers run into confusion because our README suggests using the ESM/streams API for "streaming responses" which then fails in RN. doc patch: clarify supported runtimes per bundle (node server, edge, rn/browser).

ben: CI-wise we should add a tiny Expo sample app to the SDK repo and run a smoke matrix: {expo-managed @ SDK 45+, bare RN 0.69+, metro 0.74+}. CI job should build the rn bundle, run unit smoke tests in emulator-less mode (just bundling).

lian: ACTIONS:
- ben: prepare dist/rn bundle + rn-shims + package.json exports (PR) — target by EOD Thu.
- jess: create an Expo minimal sample app (template) and notes on shims + dev experience.
- alice: docs PR clarifying runtime compatibility and typing guidance.

ci-bot: build started for branch sdk/rn-compat (CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345) :gear:

jess: thanks — i'll try the local quickfix (import 'react-native-get-random-values' + globalThis.crypto) and report back.

lian: perfect. if you hit anything else paste the full metro error, and include your expo SDK + metro versions. thx! :thumbsup:
